figures.finding: Film in Georgia (Enterprise Georgia) pays a 20% cash rebate on qualified local spend paid to local companies, plus a 2-5% uplift for projects that promote Georgia and pass a cultural test; minimum spend is GEL 500,000 for film and TV (GEL 300,000 for documentary, reality and commercials); a rebate up to GEL 1 million is approved automatically, more needs the government's approval; a local production company and a CPA audit are required and production must finish within 24 months.

figures.applies: Georgia, Georgian and foreign productions (as summarised 2026).

sources.said: Spend 20% Qualified expenditure includes local costs directly related to production and paid to local companies. See the Cash Rebate Brochure for a list of qualified expenditures. Spend Uplifts 2-5% available if projects include elements designed to promote Georgia as a destination. To qualify, projects must meet the program’s “Cultural Test”. Minimum/Caps Minimum Spend 500K GEL (film and TV); 300K GEL (documentary, reality, and commercials)
If production qualifies for the rebate, a refund up to 1M GEL will be approved automatically. Projects requesting a higher rebate require special approval of the government of Georgia.
Production in Georgia must be completed within 24 months after acceptance to the rebate program.
